{{Nihongo|'''Makoto Gonokami'''|五神 真|Gonokami Makoto|born 1957}} is a Japanese professor of science and engineering at the [[University of Tokyo]] (UTokyo), mostly in the field of [[physics]]. He served as the 30th president of UTokyo, after succeeding [[Junichi Hamada]] who retired in 2015, and until March 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bloomberg - profile of Makoto Gonokami|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/20652715|access-date=2020-07-25|website=www.bloomberg.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2015-07-14|title=Makoto Gonokami Begins UTokyo Presidency|url=https://www.friendsofutokyo.org/makoto-gonokami-begins-utokyo-presidency/|access-date=2020-07-25|website=Friends of UTokyo, Inc.|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title= List of University Presidents |url= https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/en/about/presidents.html|access-date=2021-06-10|website=www.u-tokyo.ac.jp|language=en}}</ref> After his presidency at UTokyo, he has served as the president of [[Riken]] since 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.riken.jp/en/news_pubs/news/2022/20220401_1/index.html|title=Makoto Gonokami takes office as President of RIKEN|publisher=RIKEN|date=1 April 2022|access-date=2022-08-18}}</ref>
 
He works in the graduate school of science, school of engineering in the institution before being dean in graduate school of science and vice president of the university.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Murai|first=Shusuke|date=2015-05-22|title=Head of Todai is an advocate for collaboration and diversity|url=https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2015/05/22/national/head-todai-advocate-collaboration-diversity/|access-date=2020-07-25|website=The Japan Times|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Makoto Gonokami|url=https://apru.org/people/makoto-gonokami/|access-date=2020-07-25|website=APRU|language=en-US}}</ref>

He holds a PhD in optical physics at [[University of Tokyo]] and most of his research based on Quantum physics and participate in Center for Quantum Materials.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Makoto Gonokami {{!}} Award from the Office of the President|url=https://president.ubc.ca/medal-of-excellence/2019-recipients/makoto-gonokami/|access-date=2020-07-25|website=president.ubc.ca|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=GONOKAMI Makoto|url=https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/focus/en/people/people000814.html|access-date=2020-07-25|website=The University of Tokyo|language=en}}</ref>

He served as the chair of [[International Alliance of Research Universities|IARU]] for two years (2018–2020).<ref>{{Cite web|title=IARU Presidents|url=http://www.iaruni.org/about/presidents|access-date=2020-07-25|website=www.iaruni.org}}</ref>
